findings.why: I don't know this word FNAC. Nobody tell me what it mean, I just read letters.

findings.quote: with a lobe on each side
findings.why: What is lobe? I never hear this word. I don't understand my own neck.

findings.quote: The skin is usually numbed first with an injection.
findings.why: I very scared of needle. This say injection go in skin, my hand shake just read.

findings.quote: Most lumps like this are not cancer
findings.why: I see the word cancer only. My heart beat fast. Why they put scary word for old man like me?

findings.quote: the test needs to be repeated.
findings.why: What if my sample not clear? Must I come again with needle? I so worried just thinking.

findings.quote: You can eat, drink and go about your day.
findings.why: After needle in my neck, can I drive myself home alone? Nobody say this. I have no family here.

findings.quote: Sometimes the sample is not clear enough to give an answer, and the test needs to be repeated.
findings.why: I want to know what happens next and if it means I have to take another day off work.

findings.quote: Contact the department if you have bleeding, swelling or pain that is getting worse.
findings.why: It does not say how bad is too bad, so I am not sure what to watch for while at work.

findings.quote: The needle is removed and a small dressing is put on.
findings.why: Nothing says whether I can drive myself home after the test.
I would like to know if results come sooner when there is a problem.
I don't know what those letters stand for, so I can't understand or research what is actually being done to me.

findings.quote: Most lumps like this are not cancer
findings.why: 'Most' isn't a number; I want the actual percentage of these lumps that turn out benign versus cancer before I can take it in.

findings.quote: Sometimes the sample is not clear enough to give an answer, and the test needs to be repeated.
findings.why: It never says how often this happens or what a repeat means, so I worry I could get stuck doing more than one needle test without being told.

findings.quote: If you have not heard after 3 weeks, please call the department.
findings.why: Results are said to take only 1 to 2 weeks, so I don't understand why I must sit in silence for a full 3 weeks before I'm allowed to call and ask what's going on.

findings.quote: Contact the department if you have bleeding, swelling or pain that is getting worse.
findings.why: No phone number is written down, so I do not know who to ring if this happens.

findings.quote: If you have not heard after 3 weeks, please call the department.
findings.why: There is no department phone number given anywhere for me to call.

findings.quote: Sometimes the sample is not clear enough to give an answer, and the test needs to be repeated.
findings.why: This worries me that it may not find out the answer the first time.
Waiting up to two weeks without knowing whether it is cancer is frightening.
